### PAINT_CTRL

Index 0x0A. Paint source and image options.

| Bits | Field | Reset | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| 13 | GAUSS | 0x0 | 3 x 3 Gaussian filter with GAUSS_W, overrides FILTER (rendering.md 7.3, v1.6b). |
| 12 | STENCIL | 0x0 | Stencil image mode: the image is per-channel alpha for PAINT_COLOR (rendering.md 5.3.1, v1.6). |
| 11 | BORDER_SOLID | 0x0 | WRAP = COLOR only: 0 the border colour is a texel (default), 1 a plain colour for pixels whose sample centre is outside (rendering.md 7.5). |
| 10:8 | WRAP | 0x0 | Image wrap: 0 NONE, 1 COLOR, 2 PAD, 3 REPEAT, 4 REFLECT (rendering.md 7.5). |
| 7:6 | SPREAD | 0x0 | Gradient spread: 0 PAD, 1 REPEAT, 2 REFLECT, 3 FILL. |
| 5 | PERSP | 0x0 | Perspective divide enable. |
| 4 | FILTER | 0x0 | 0 POINT, 1 BILINEAR. |
| 3 | SRC_PREMUL | 0x0 | Premultiply source texels on read. |
| 2 | IMG_MUL | 0x0 | Image mode MULTIPLY by PAINT_COLOR. |
| 1:0 | SRC | 0x0 | 0 SOLID, 1 IMAGE, 2 LINEAR_GRAD, 3 RADIAL_GRAD (rendering.md 10.4). |
